verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered automation in the evidence is Alerts. A user defines a research topic, and Elicit sends instant email alerts whenever a new relevant paper is found, with results that can be added to the Library. This is a single fixed event-to-action pattern, not a general rules engine; the API and MCP access only allow user-built automation outside the product. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger conditions beyond topic matching, configurable actions other than email notification (e.g. auto-adding to collections, auto-running extraction or agent sessions), webhooks or event subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
